messages:
Maria: FYI promote is blocked in verify after a cache-prune started during prefetch. getting manifest 412s from artifact-index. :warning:
Aj: noticed it too. deploybot UI shows repeated verify failures for a handful of artifacts, looks like prune raced with prefetch.
Sourav: paste from index logs:
```
2026-03-22T03:09:58Z cache-prune start shard=21 range=[2026-02-28..2026-03-22]
2026-03-22T03:09:59Z index: delete /index/shard-21/manifest/sha256:beef...
2026-03-22T03:10:00Z verify: read index for sha256:beef... -> 412 manifest missing
2026-03-22T03:10:00Z deploybot: verify retry id=sha256:beef... attempt=2
2026-03-22T03:10:01Z deploybot: verify queue contention; waiting on index lock
```
Tay: this is similar to last-quarter's thundering-verifies. parallel prefetch + prune causes a narrow window where manifests are deleted mid-verify.
deploybot: promotion paused at verify. default behavior: exponential backoff up to 10m. pending verifies: 33.
Maria: change window closes in ~45m. Decision needed: 1) pin to last-known-good and force promote, or 2) attempt shard repair (longer).
Aj: last-known-good (sha256:0912...) passed canary and smoke earlier. it's missing today's tiny fix but acceptable.
Sourav: pros/cons: pin = unblock release now; repair = fix root cause but may miss window.
Tay: +1 pin. We should follow up with a prune quiesce around deploys and add an alert for verify-queue >20 after prune.
ci-bot: regression check: sha256:0912 passed full matrix this morning.
Maria: ok I'm going to run manual promote to sha256:0912 in 2m unless objections.
Aj: +1 from release. include rollback hook in notes.
Sourav: opening ARTIFACT-911: investigate prune vs prefetch race; adding logs and shard id.
Maria: executing /promote --image sha256:0912 --reason "pin due to index prune verify failures"
deploybot: promote request accepted. skipping prefetch. verify queued on runner-11.
deploybot: verify passed on runner-11 id=sha256:0912. promotion continuing to rollout.
deploybot: rollout complete. change-window preserved. :tada:
Maria: release notes: "Pinned to last-known-good image due to artifact-index prune-induced verify failures during prefetch. Follow-ups: prune quiesce during deploys, shard-repair automation, post-release index integrity check (ARTIFACT-911)."
Tay: also add INFRA-121 for prune-after-deploy guard and an alert rule for verify-queue spikes.
Aj: adding RELEASE-421 for post-release validation and rollback test.
Sourav: pinging artifact-index on-call with logs and prune timestamp.
Maria: thanks all. closing thread.
